Lionel Messi (born June 24, 1987, Rosario, Argentina) is an Argentine-born football (soccer) player who received a record-setting eight Ballon d’Or awards as the world’s top male player (2009–12, 2015, 2019, 2021, and 2023). In 2022 he helped Argentina win the Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA)’s World Cup. He is the tournament’s second highest goalscorer with a total of 21 goals, just one behind France’s Kylian Mbappé. Both Messi and Mbappé overtook German footballer [...] Top Questions

### Why is Lionel Messi famous?

Lionel Messi is an Argentine-bornfootball(soccer) player who has been named the world’s best men’s player of the year seven times (2009–12, 2015, 2019, and 2021). In 2022 he helped Argentina win theWorld Cup. Naturally left-footed, quick, and precise in control of the ball, Messi is known as a keen pass distributor and can readily thread his way through packed defenses.

### What was Lionel Messi’s childhood like? [...] Messi Magic

Lionel Messi is Argentina’s youngest and oldest player to score in a FIFA World Cup. He was 18 when he scored his first World Cup goal, against Serbia and Montenegro (now the independent countries of Serbia and Montenegro) in June 2006. Exactly 20 years later, in June 2026, he scored his historic hat trick against Algeria at the age of 38 years 357 days.

With a nation on his back and a career full of mythical achievements, Lionel Messi pursued the Holy Grail of world's football. For many years, the missing piece of his larger-than-life football story. A World Cup with the colors of the Albiceleste.
I have seen the player who will inherit my place in Argentine football and his name is Messi. Messi is a genius. [...] Diego Maradona
### 2006: Messi's first steps on the big stage
Messi's FIFA World Cup journey started in 2006. Still carrying the label of Argentina's new wonderkid, Messi was included in the 23-man squad of José Pékerman for the tournament in Germany. After watching the opening match from the bench, Messi got his first playing time, first assist and first goal in a World Cup, in the 6-0 win over Serbia and Montenegro. Taking a spot at the starting XI of the final group match against the Netherlands, Messi then had his first taste of World Cup knockout football on the day of his 19th birthday in Argentina's 2-1 extra-time win over Mexico.

## About
Star soccer forward who gained world fame playing with FC Barcelona and as captain of Argentina's national team. He won the Ballon d'Or four straight years from 2009 to 2012. He received the Golden Ball Award at the 2014 and 2022 World Cups, leading Argentina to a World Cup championship on the latter occasion. In August 2021, he left FC Barcelona to play for Paris Saint-Germain FC and in June of 2023 he joined Inter Miami CF.
